2. The facts relevant for disposal of the appeal in a nut-shell can be stated thus, that the present appellant as plaintiff instituted a Title Suit being Other Suit No.173 of 2015 in the 1" Court of learned Joint District Judge, Bogra for declaration of title and also for a declaration that the Heba-bil-awaj deed No.4204 dated 24.03.2014 made in favour of the defendant No.1 by the original owner of the land is forged, created and not binding upon the plaintiff contending inter alia that the suit property described in the schedule of the plaint appertaining to C.S. khatian No.671 corresponding to J.L No.82 in Plot No.2307 comprising an area of 33 decimals of land under Mouza Sutrapur of district and P.S. Bogra originally belonged to one Sirajul Hoque, Meherunnessa and Atorjan Bibi. The recorded tenants had been owning and possessing the suit property in ejmali. Subsequently, by way of inheritance Sirajul Hoque acquired the land in 16 annas share and the subsequent M.R.R. Khatian No.917 has been finally prepared in his name. Thereafter, Sirajul Hoque by a registered Heba-bil-awaj deed No.11505 transferred the land in favour of his daughter Surjatunnahar and his sons namely A.K.M. Helaluzzaman and Hayatuzzaman. Surjatun Nahar mutated her portion of land and paid rent to the government and obtained rent receipts. Similarly Hayatuzzaman vide separate Mutation Case No.167(9-1)79-80 dated 04.01.1980 mutated his portion of land measuring .0800 Ajutangsha and paid rent to the government. The plaintiff-appellant on 10.12.2013 made an affidavit stating that the attorney of the original owner gifted the suit land in favour of the plaintiff-appellant and on the basis of that gift the plaintiff-appellant is possessing the suit properties and in fact the original owner of the land Dr. Surjatunnahar did not reside in the suit properties and never demanded the suit land as of her own. 'On 28.05.2015 the plaintiff-appellant came to learn that the defendant No.1 is claiming the land stating that on 24.03.2015 vide registered Heba-bil-awaj deed No.4204 he has acquired right, title, interest in the suit land. In fact; the owner of the land Dr. Surjatun Nahar on the basis of an oral gift through her am-moktar Md. Helaluzzaman Talukder transferred the suit land in favour of the plaintiff on 10.12.2013 by virtue of an affidavit before Notary Public, Bogra and as a result subsequent Heba-bil-awaj deed in favour of the defendant No.1 is forged, fabricated and not binding upon the plaintiff. 

 8. We have considered the submissions and cited decisions of the learned Advocates and have gone through the impugned judgment and order passed by the learned trial court along with the certified copies of the plaint which is annexed herewith as Annexure-'A' in Other Suit No.173 of 2015 field by the plaintiff-appellant against of the defendant-respondents in respect of the suit properties described in the schedule of the plaint corresponding to Mouza-Sutrapur under District and P.S.-Bogra Sadar in J.L. No.82 corresponding to C.S. khatian No.671 & MRR Khatian No.917, Bujarat No.7328 and Plot No.2307(old) and recent plot No.7296 comprising an area of land 8.00 decimals out of 2400 decimals of land along with a three storied building therein.
